feeds.title: Barbershop Harmony Society Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1938, the Barbershop Harmony Society preserves and extends the reach of a uniquely American close harmony musical art form whose roots lie in African-American improvisation and European harmony traditions. Stay up-to-date on all things barbershop.

feeds.title: Harmony Kings Blog
feeds.description: For over 50 years the Federal Way Harmony Kings have been performing tight four-part harmony throughout the South Puget Sound (WA) area. Our quartets LOVE to sing! They sing at birthday parties, weddings, business get-togethers, anniversaries, and yes, even funerals and memorial services.

feeds.title: Sunshine District
feeds.description: Sunshine District is part of the Barbershop Harmony Society that comprises the entire state of Florida. From Tallahassee to Miami, we spread the joy of singing in the barbershop style.

feeds.title: Far Western District
feeds.description: The Far Western District provides leadership and assistance to our members and chapters, while maintaining our status as an innovative district, in order to perpetuate barbershop harmony and encourage vocal music in our schools and communities.

feeds.title: Lemon Squeezy Blog
feeds.description: Lemon Squeezy was founded on a dark and snowy night at the beginning of February 2010. Since then, the quartet has developed a crisp and delightful sound throughout a big variety of songs, ranging from Swedish men's choir to Elvis Presley.

feeds.title: Inner Coach of Barbershop Blog
feeds.description: Since 2007, Jan Carley, Inner Coach of Barbershop, Professional Executive Coach and long-time Barbershop quartet and chorus singer, has transformed the experiences of thousands of barbershoppers worldwide with her personal mastery, leadership and chorus culture work. Get it all here.

feeds.title: Pacific Sound
feeds.description: Pacific Sound Chorus formed in early 2000 with a goal of good friends working hard and presenting excellent a cappella music, Barbershop Harmony Style. Subscribe, to get the latest news about them.

feeds.title: The British Association of Barbershop Singers Blog
feeds.description: The British Association of Barbershop Singers (BABS) is a registered charity supporting male and mixed barbershop harmony singing in the UK. We are the largest such organization outside of North America and have more than 60 registered choruses (choirs) and 100 registered barbershop quartets across the country.
